steps.en: Install it and add its object-permission backend ahead of Django's ModelBackend
steps.zh: 装好它，把它的对象权限后端加在 ModelBackend 前面

steps.en: Write predicates and bind their combination to a permission name
steps.zh: 写判断函数，组合后绑定到一个权限名

steps.en: Guard a view or template with that permission name and the object
steps.zh: 在视图或模板上用这个权限名加对象做守卫

steps.en: On each check, Django asks its backend, which looks up the rule for that name
steps.zh: 每次检查时 Django 询问它的后端，后端按名字找到规则

steps.en: Runs the predicates on user and object, short-circuiting, and returns allow or deny
steps.zh: 拿用户和对象跑判断函数，短路求值，返回放行或拒绝

value.en: Per-object authorization lives in named, testable functions — no permission rows to store or sync
value.zh: 按对象的授权变成有名字、可测试的函数，不用存也不用同步权限行

sources: https://github.com/dfunckt/django-rules#permissions (rules.add_perm('books.change_book', is_book_author | is_editor), has_perm asks each backend)
